root_cause.text: A data race occurs because the `sk_data_ready` and `sk_write_space` function pointers in `struct sock` are modified concurrently by layers like `skmsg` while being read by other CPUs without proper synchronization annotations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `READ_ONCE()` and `WRITE_ONCE()` annotations to all reads and writes of `sk->sk_data_ready` and `sk->sk_write_space` across `net/core/skmsg.c`, `net/ipv4/tcp.c`, `net/ipv4/tcp_input.c`, `net/ipv4/udp.c`, and `net/unix/af_unix.c`.
